title: Testing Reducers
description: Learn how to write unit tests for Redux reducers.

data.text: Testing reducers is straightforward because they are pure functions. Given the same input, they always return the same output.

data.title: Reducer Test
Pure Functions
data.text: Reducers are pure functions, making them the easiest Redux logic to test. No mocking required.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Reducer tests are simple and fast.
